narr: A broken line of thunderstorms moved across this area of the Ohio Valley just ahead of an approaching cold front. While thunderstorms were generally moving fast enough to avoid flooding issues, some locations received multiple rounds of heavy rainfall as multiple convective segments moved across, and in some instances trained across the same area. This led to some isolated instances of flooding in Ohio and Pennsylvania.
ev: Law enforcement reported numerous roads closed including: Route 566, Route 564, Route 285, and Windy Ridge Road due to high water.
